mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it indicates labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% (y/y), or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index signals expanding manufacturing output and economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth exceeds 2.0%, it signals strong economic expansion that boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% (q/q), or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls and declining unemployment indicate a strengthening labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month and UNRATE decreases by at least 0.1 percentage points, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), consumer spending is depressed and corporate earnings growth is constrained, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
